data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F for June 30, 2026 shows positions in NEWT and USCB.

On June 30, 2026, NewtekOne reported net loans and leases of $1.53B, up 62.4% q/q and 110.9% y/y; total loans including held for sale rose 21.5% q/q. (https://cdr.ffiec.gov/public/ViewFacsimileDirect.aspx?ds=call&idType=ID_RSSD&id=502111&date=06302026)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
